topics.sample_question: I've been through a breakup that took me completely off guard. I thought everything was fine, and now that it's over, I feel like I've lost part of myself in the process.
topics.sample_answer: Grieving the end of a relationship is one of the most intense forms of emotional pain. It's okay to cry and miss them. Healing isn't forgetting overnight; it's learning to reinvest love back into yourself.
topics.keywords: breakup, putus cinta, patah hati, mantan, move on, gagal pacaran, sakit hati putus

topics.name: Kesulitan Menghadapi Mantan yang Masih Satu Kampus / Kelas
topics.description: Kecanggungan dan rasa sakit melihat mantan pacar setiap hari di lorong fakultas, kerja kelompok bersama, atau melihatnya dekat dengan orang baru.
topics.prompt_context: Pengguna tersiksa melihat mantan di kampus. Bantu buat protokol interaksi minimal dan batasi pengawasan visual di media sosial.
suggested_chips: Satu kelas sama mantan bikin canggung
Nyesek liat mantan udah akrab sama orang baru
Susah fokus kuliah gara-gara mantan sefakultas
topics.sample_question: Having to sit in the same lecture hall with my ex three times a week is pure torture. Seeing them laugh while I'm crying inside makes me want to drop the class.
topics.sample_answer: Navigating an ex's physical presence requires intentional boundaries. Keep interactions strictly academic, sit where they aren't in your direct line of sight, and lean on supportive peers.
topics.keywords: mantan satu kelas, sefakultas, mantan pacar kampus, canggung ketemu mantan, mantan punya pacar baru

topics.name: Hubungan Jarak Jauh (LDR), Masalah Kepercayaan & Kecurigaan
topics.description: Kecemasan akibat pacaran beda kota/pulau, overthinking saat pasangan lama membalas pesan, dan godaan rasa curiga berkepanjangan.
topics.prompt_context: Pengguna mengalami overthinking dalam LDR. Bantu bedakan antara kecurigaan emosional dengan bukti faktual, serta perbaiki kualitas komunikasi.
suggested_chips: Pasangan lama bales chat langsung curiga
Capek kangen tapi cuma bisa video call
Komunikasi LDR makin dingin dan hambar
topics.sample_question: Long-distance relationship is taking a massive toll on my sanity. Whenever they take three hours to reply, my mind spirals into imagining them cheating.
topics.sample_answer: Distance magnifies insecurity because your brain tries to fill in visual gaps with worst-case assumptions. Schedule predictable communication times rather than demanding constant real-time texting.
topics.keywords: ldr, pacaran jarak jauh, curiga pasangan, overthinking ldr, pacar selingkuh, lama balas chat

topics.name: Kecemburuan Berlebihan & Memeriksa Gawai Pasangan Terus-Menerus
topics.description: Kecemasan pasangan berpaling, dorongan memeriksa riwayat chat HP pasangan secara diam-diam, dan rasa insecure yang membebani hubungan.
topics.prompt_context: Pengguna bergulat dengan kecemburuan obsesif. Bantu mereka melihat apakah kecemburuan ini berasal dari trauma diselingkuhi di masa lalu.
suggested_chips: Insecure dibanding teman lawan jenis pasangan
topics.sample_question: I've been dealing with intense jealousy in my relationship. I constantly snoop through their phone, track their follower counts, and I know it's poisoning our bond.
topics.sample_answer: Jealousy often points to our own underlying fear of abandonment and feeling inadequate. Snooping provides momentary relief followed by greater suspicion. Let's address your internal security.
topics.keywords: cemburu berlebihan, cek hp pacar, snoop, cemburu buta, insecure pacaran, takut diselingkuhi

topics.name: Hubungan Toksik (Manipulatif, Gaslighting, Putus-Nyambung)
topics.description: Terjebak dalam hubungan manipulatif, selalu disalahkan, pasangan playing victim, dan siklus putus-nyambung berulang yang menguras energi.
topics.prompt_context: Pengguna berada dalam toxic relationship. Dengarkan tanpa menghakimi mengapa mereka sulit lepas, bantu kenali tanda manipulasi, dan rencanakan keselamatan emosional.
topics.sample_question: I feel trapped in an exhausting cycle with my partner. Whenever we argue, they twist things so it becomes my fault, leaving me feeling guilty and mentally abused.
topics.sample_answer: Emotional manipulation distorts your sense of reality and erodes your confidence. Recognizing that this pattern isn't healthy is a powerful first step toward reclaiming your peace.
topics.keywords: toxic relationship, hubungan toksik, manipulasi, gaslighting, putus nyambung, pasangan playing victim

topics.name: Ketakutan Berkomitmen (Commitment Phobia) atau Takut Ditinggalkan
topics.description: Dilema saat ada orang baik yang mendekati namun merasa panik dan ingin melarikan diri karena takut tersakiti di masa depan.
topics.prompt_context: Pengguna memiliki gaya kelekatan cemas/menghindar (avoidant/anxious attachment). Bantu mereka menyadari pola pertahanan emosi tersebut.
suggested_chips: Takut komitmen pas hubungan mulai serius
Pengen kabur pas ada orang yang tulus mendekat
Takut ditinggalkan kalau udah sayang banget
topics.sample_question: Whenever a relationship gets serious and intimate, I freak out and sabotage it. I push good people away because I'm terrified they'll see my flaws and abandon me.
topics.sample_answer: Pushing people away before they can hurt you is a common defense mechanism rooted in fear of abandonment. Vulnerability is terrifying, but it is also the only gateway to genuine connection.
topics.keywords: takut komitmen, commitment issues, takut ditinggalkan, avoidant attachment, sabotase hubungan

topics.name: Cinta Bertepuk Sebelah Tangan & Terjebak Friendzone
topics.description: Rasa sakit memendam perasaan cinta pada sahabat sendiri selama bertahun-tahun tanpa berani mengungkapkan, atau ditolak dan terjebak status teman.
topics.prompt_context: Pengguna terjebak friendzone. Bantu mereka berdamai dengan kenyataan dan pertimbangkan untuk memberi jarak sementara demi menyembuhkan luka hati.
suggested_chips: Sakit hati denger dia curhat soal gebetannya
Bingung mau confess atau tetap diam
topics.sample_question: I've been hopelessly in love with my best friend for two years. Yesterday they told me about someone they're dating, and smiling through that conversation broke me completely.
topics.sample_answer: Unrequited love hurts just like a breakup because the hoped-for future disappears. You are allowed to take space from this friendship to protect your heart until your feelings settle.
topics.keywords: friendzone, cinta bertepuk sebelah tangan, unrequited love, naksir sahabat, pendam rasa

subcategories.name: Kecemasan Sosial, Isolasi & Kesepian
subcategories.description: Rasa canggung akut di ruang publik, takut dinilai aneh, mengisolasi diri, dan kesepian mendalam di keramaian.

topics.name: Social Anxiety & Ketakutan Berbicara di Depan Publik / Kelas
topics.description: Gemetar hebat saat harus presentasi di depan kelas, takut ditertawakan saat bertanya, dan cemas dihakimi orang asing.
topics.prompt_context: Pengguna mengalami kecemasan sosial hebat. Bantu mereka menurunkan fokus dari 'apa kata orang' menjadi 'pesan apa yang ingin kusampaikan', serta latihan desensitisasi bertahap.
suggested_chips: Takut dinilai jelek sama orang lain
Susah mulai obrolan sama orang baru
Malu banget kalau jadi pusat perhatian
topics.sample_question: Whenever I have to speak in class or meet new people, my heart races and I feel like everyone is judging and laughing at me. I'd rather stay quiet and disappear.
topics.sample_answer: Social anxiety convinces us that a spotlight is constantly focused on our flaws. In reality, most people are absorbed in their own worries. You don't have to be charismatic—just speaking your genuine thought is enough.
topics.keywords: social anxiety, cemas sosial, presentasi, public speaking, dinilai orang, gugup, pemalu, canggung

topics.name: Rasa Canggung Ekstrem Saat Memulai Percakapan dengan Orang Baru
topics.description: Kebingungan mencari topik obrolan (small talk), takut dianggap aneh, dan rasa canggung yang membuat interaksi sosial terasa menyiksa.
topics.prompt_context: Pengguna canggung saat memulai obrolan. Berikan teknik open-ended questions sederhana dan latih apresiasi interaksi mikro.
suggested_chips: Bingung mau ngomong apa pas ketemu orang baru
Takut dicap aneh pas buka obrolan
topics.sample_question: I freeze up completely when someone sits next to me in class. I have no idea how to make small talk, and the silence feels so unbearably awkward that I just stare at my phone.
topics.sample_answer: Small talk is just an acoustic handshake, not an audition. A simple comment on the class, the professor, or asking an open question like 'What major are you?' is all it takes.
topics.keywords: canggung, small talk, mulai obrolan, orang baru, mati gaya, awkward, kaku bicara

topics.name: Kesepian Mendalam (Loneliness) di Tengah Keramaian Kampus
topics.description: Merasa sendirian meskipun berada di tengah ribuan mahasiswa di kampus, tidak memiliki tempat curhat yang aman, dan merasa tidak dipahami siapapun.
topics.prompt_context: Pengguna merasa kesepian dan terasing. Hadirkan kehangatan konseling, validasi rasa sepi sebagai kebutuhan mendasar manusia akan koneksi, bukan aib.
suggested_chips: Nggak punya teman cerita yang tulus
Ngerasa nggak ada yang ngerti keadaanku
Mengurung diri di kamar kosan terus
topics.sample_question: I feel so lonely and isolated. Even when I am surrounded by hundreds of classmates in the campus plaza, I feel like a ghost that no one sees or truly cares about.
topics.sample_answer: Loneliness in a crowd is one of the heaviest feelings. It isn't about the number of bodies around you, but the depth of emotional understanding. I hear you, and your presence truly matters.
topics.keywords: lonely, loneliness, kesepian, terasing, alone, sendirian, terisolasi, hampa sosial, kesepian kampus

topics.name: Mengurung Diri di Kamar Kosan & Menarik Diri dari Kehidupan Sosial
topics.description: Kecenderungan mengunci diri di kamar kosan berhari-hari, menolak ajakan keluar, dan perlahan memutuskan kontak dengan dunia luar.
topics.prompt_context: Pengguna mengisolasi diri secara kronis. Berikan dorongan keluar secara bertahap (misal: duduk di teras kosan 10 menit menghirup udara segar).
suggested_chips: Mengurung diri di kamar kosan berhari-hari
topics.sample_question: I haven't left my boarding room for five days except to pick up food deliveries. Interacting with anyone feels terrifying and exhausting, so I just hide in bed.
topics.sample_answer: Isolation feels safe in the short term, but it reinforces the anxiety barrier over time. Let's start with a micro-step today: opening your window or taking a 5-minute walk outside.
topics.keywords: mengurung diri, kamar kosan, menarik diri, isolasi sosial, antisosial, malas ketemu orang

topics.name: Kelelahan Sosial (Social Hangover / Introvert Burnout) Pasca Acara
topics.description: Energi batin terkuras habis setelah menghadiri acara seminar, kepanitiaan, atau kumpul keluarga, membutuhkan waktu berhari-hari untuk pulih.
topics.prompt_context: Pengguna mengalami social hangover. Berikan pemahaman tentang kebutuhan baterai sosial introvert dan strategi pengisian ulang energi.
suggested_chips: Baterai sosial habis total sehabis kumpul
Butuh waktu berhari-hari menyendiri buat pulih
Pusing dan capek setelah acara ramai
topics.sample_question: After attending a 3-hour campus event yesterday, I woke up feeling emotionally battered and unable to speak to anyone. My social battery is completely in the negative.
topics.sample_answer: A 'social hangover' is a real neurological phenomenon for introverts and sensitive individuals. Honor your need for quiet recharge time without viewing it as antisocial behavior.
topics.keywords: social hangover, baterai sosial, introvert burnout, kelelahan sosial, energi sosial habis, butuh sendiri

topics.name: Ketakutan Menjadi Pusat Perhatian atau Dinilai Aneh oleh Orang Asing
topics.description: Kecemasan parah saat harus berjalan sendirian di koridor kampus, merasa semua mata menatap dan menilai gaya berjalan atau pakaiannya.
topics.prompt_context: Pengguna mengalami Spotlight Effect. Jelaskan bahwa orang lain pada kenyataannya terlalu sibuk memikirkan diri mereka sendiri untuk memperhatikan kita.
suggested_chips: Malu banget jalan sendirian di kampus
Ngerasa semua orang lagi ngeliatin dan ngehakimi
Takut dinilai aneh gaya pakaian atau jalannya
Pengen jadi orang yang nggak keliatan
topics.sample_question: I hate walking through the university cafeteria alone. I feel like every single table is staring at me, judging how I walk, and whispering about how pathetic I look.
topics.sample_answer: This is the psychological 'Spotlight Effect'. In truth, almost everyone around you is absorbed in their own phone, their own insecurities, and their own deadlines. The spotlight is an illusion.
topics.keywords: spotlight effect, pusat perhatian, dinilai aneh, jalan sendirian, malu di kampus, dihakimi orang

topics.name: Kesulitan Menemukan Teman yang Memiliki Frekuensi dan Nilai Sama
topics.description: Rasa hampa karena memiliki kenalan banyak di kampus namun tidak ada satupun yang benar-benar cocok diajak berdiskusi mendalam.
topics.prompt_context: Pengguna mencari pertemanan bermakna. Dorong keterlibatan dalam komunitas minat spesifik (hobi, buku, kerelawanan) daripada sekadar circle perkuliahan.
suggested_chips: Banyak kenalan tapi nggak ada yang sefrekuensi
Obrolan teman kampus rasanya dangkal semua
Pengen punya teman diskusi yang mendalam
topics.sample_question: I have dozens of acquaintances on campus, but zero real friends. All our conversations revolve around superficial gossip or assignment due dates. I crave deep, authentic connection.
topics.sample_answer: Quality connection requires shared values, not just shared classrooms. Look toward specialized interest clubs, volunteer groups, or creative circles where authentic bonds naturally form.
topics.keywords: teman sefrekuensi, obrolan dangkal, teman tulus, koneksi mendalam, superficial friends, kesepian intelektual

subcategories.name: Batasan Diri (Boundaries), Konflik & Bullying
subcategories.description: Ketidakmampuan menolak permintaan orang lain, takut dijauhi, beban memikul masalah orang lain, dan perundungan.

topics.name: People Pleasing & Selalu Berkata 'Ya' Meskipun Tertekan
topics.description: Selalu menyetujui permintaan tolong orang lain meskipun mengorbankan waktu, energi, dan kesehatan sendiri karena takut dibenci.
topics.prompt_context: Pengguna terjebak people-pleasing kronis. Ajarkan bahwa 'tidak' adalah kalimat lengkap dan menetapkan batasan adalah bentuk penghormatan pada diri sendiri.
suggested_chips: Susah banget bilang nggak ke orang lain
topics.sample_question: I'm always terrified of disappointing people, so I keep saying yes to every favor until I'm burnt out. I feel like if I set boundaries, people will stop liking me.
topics.sample_answer: When you say yes to everyone else at your own expense, you are continually saying no to your own well-being. Saying 'no' kindly is not selfish; it protects the quality of your relationships.
topics.keywords: people pleaser, people pleasing, batas, boundaries, nolak, bilang tidak, dimanfaatin, takut dibenci

topics.name: Rasa Bersalah Mendalam Saat Harus Menolak Permintaan Orang Lain
topics.description: Munculnya rasa gelisah dan bersalah berhari-hari setelah menolak meminjamkan catatan, kendaraan, atau menolak ajakan nongkrong teman.
topics.prompt_context: Pengguna merasa bersalah setelah menetapkan batasan. Latih dekonstruksi rasa bersalah bahwa menolak tugas orang lain bukanlah kejahatan.
suggested_chips: Ngerasa bersalah banget habis nolak permintaan teman
Pengen minta maaf padahal hakku buat nolak
topics.sample_question: I finally said no to a classmate who asked to copy my assignment, and now I've spent the entire afternoon sweating with guilt, wanting to text them an apology.
topics.sample_answer: Feeling guilty after setting a healthy boundary is normal when you're used to self-sacrificing. Sit with the uncomfortable feeling; it is the price of reclaiming your personal space.
topics.keywords: rasa bersalah nolak, boundaries guilt, kepikiran nolak, bilang tidak gelisah, menolak teman

topics.name: Dikelilingi Orang yang Sering Memanfaatkan Kebaikan Diri
topics.description: Frustrasi menyadari bahwa orang-orang sekitar hanya mendekat ketika membutuhkan bantuan akademik, uang, atau tumpangan kendaraan.
topics.prompt_context: Pengguna merasa dimanfaatkan. Bantu mereka mengidentifikasi relasi transaksional toksik dan berani menarik diri dari dinamika tersebut.
suggested_chips: Teman cuma ramah pas butuh contekan tugas
Capek jadi ban serep orang lain
topics.sample_question: I'm always the one lending my vehicle, sharing my study notes, and paying for group snacks. When I ask for a small favor, they make excuses. I feel like a convenient doormat.
topics.sample_answer: Being kind is a strength, but lacking boundaries turns kindness into self-erasure. You are not obligated to be available for people who only remember you during emergencies.
topics.keywords: dimanfaatkan, tidak enakan, dimanfaatin teman, doormat, kebaikan dieksploitasi, teman pamrih

topics.name: Korban Bullying, Olok-Olok, atau Cyberbullying dari Rekan Kampus
topics.description: Pengalaman diolok-olok fisik, dikucilkan secara sengaja, diserang di media sosial, atau direndahkan oleh rekan kampus.
topics.prompt_context: Pengguna mengalami perundungan. Tegaskan bahwa perlakuan buruk tersebut bukan salah mereka, dukung pemulihan rasa aman, dan dorong melapor ke unit kampus terkait.
suggested_chips: Jadi korban omongan jahat di kampus
Takut masuk kelas karena ada pembully
topics.sample_question: I feel so lost, I've had to deal with bullying and mockery at school/college, and it's affecting my health. I want to stand up for myself, but I'm terrified.
topics.sample_answer: Bullying is never your fault, and you do not deserve to be treated with hostility. Your safety is top priority. Let's look at trusted campus counselors or mentors who can step in to protect you.
topics.keywords: bullying, bully, perundungan, diejek, diolok, cyberbullying, korban bully, intimidasi kampus

topics.name: Menghadapi Sikap Pasif-Agresif & Sindiran di Media Sosial
topics.description: Stres menghadapi teman atau anggota kelompok yang suka menyindir lewat status WhatsApp, Threads, atau Twitter tanpa berani bicara langsung.
topics.prompt_context: Pengguna tertekan oleh sindiran pasif-agresif. Anjurkan untuk tidak membalas sindiran di medsos dan fokus pada klarifikasi langsung atau pengabaian total.
suggested_chips: Disindir lewat status medsos sama teman
Malas ladenin drama di media sosial
topics.sample_question: A member of my group project keeps posting passive-aggressive indirect tweets and status updates mocking our team's pace instead of talking to us directly.
topics.sample_answer: Passive-aggressive behavior stems from an inability to communicate maturely. Do not feed the drama by posting counter-subtweets. Address the project facts directly or ignore the noise.
topics.keywords: pasif agresif, sindiran medsos, disindir status, tweet sindiran, drama medsos, kode-kodean

topics.name: Belajar Berkomunikasi Asertif Tanpa Menjadi Agresif
topics.description: Keinginan untuk mampu menyampaikan ketidaksetujuan atau perasaan tersinggung secara tegas dan tenang tanpa emosi meledak-ledak.
topics.prompt_context: Pengguna ingin belajar asertivitas. Latih formula asertif: 'Ketika Anda melakukan X, saya merasa Y, dan saya ingin ke depannya kita Z.'
suggested_chips: Pengen bisa tegas tanpa keliatan galak
Cara ngomong jujur tanpa bikin orang sakit hati
Gimana cara negur teman yang salah?
topics.sample_question: I want to improve my communication skills and find ways to express my thoughts and boundaries without feeling overwhelmed or coming across as hostile.
topics.sample_answer: Assertiveness is the balance between passivity and aggression. It means stating your truth clearly without violating the dignity of the other person. Let's practice phrasing your boundaries.
topics.keywords: asertif, komunikasi asertif, tegas tenang, menegur sopan, menyampaikan keberatan, batas diri

topics.name: Menjaga Batasan Sehat Terhadap Teman Kosan / Roommate yang Mengganggu
topics.description: Konflik mengenai kebersihan kamar kos, kebisingan larut malam, atau teman kosan yang sering meminjam barang tanpa izin.
topics.prompt_context: Pengguna berkonflik dengan teman kosan/roommate. Bantu buat kesepakatan aturan bersama (ground rules) kosan secara tertulis dan santai.
suggested_chips: Roommate kosan berisik banget tengah malam
Teman kosan jorok dan nggak jaga kebersihan
Barang pribadi sering dipakai tanpa izin
topics.sample_question: My dorm roommate stays up screaming on gaming calls until 3 AM and never cleans their dishes. I dread going back to my own room every single evening.
topics.sample_answer: Living with someone requires mutual ground rules. Approach them at a calm moment (not at 3 AM) and propose shared house boundaries that protect both your sleep and friendship.
topics.keywords: roommate, teman kosan, kos-kosan, sekamar, berisik tengah malam, kebersihan kos, batas roommate

name: Gaya Hidup, Kebiasaan & Regulasi Diri
description: Manajemen ritme hidup harian, kualitas tidur, kebiasaan digital, persepsi tubuh fisik, serta teknik koping self-care mandiri.

subcategories.name: Pola Tidur & Kebugaran Istirahat
subcategories.description: Kesulitan tidur, insomnia malam hari, jam tidur terbalik akibat begadang tugas, dan rasa lelah saat bangun.

topics.name: Insomnia Kronis & Jam Tidur Terbalik Menjelang Subuh
topics.description: Terbiasa tidur menjelang subuh dan terbangun siang hari, membuat ritme sirkadian terganggu dan suasana hati labil.
topics.prompt_context: Pengguna mengalami insomnia dan jam tidur terbalik. Berikan panduan Sleep Hygiene praktis: batasi kafein sore, redupkan layar 1 jam sebelum tidur, dan jaga suhu kamar.
topics.sample_question: I've been having trouble sleeping lately, tossing and turning for hours. My sleep schedule is completely inverted, and I wake up feeling exhausted and cranky every day.
topics.sample_answer: Sleep disruptions quickly amplify emotional fragility. Let's reset your internal clock gradually by establishing a wind-down routine 45 minutes before bedtime without screens.
topics.keywords: sleep, tidur, insomnia, begadang, jam tidur, melek, susah tidur, bangun lemas, sleep hygiene

topics.name: Begadang Rutin Akibat Mengerjakan Tugas di Malam Hari
topics.description: Kebiasaan lembur tugas hingga larut malam yang berakibat pada penurunan imunitas tubuh, sakit kepala, dan mata lelah.
topics.prompt_context: Pengguna terjebak siklus begadang tugas. Bantu kelola ritme jam kerja di siang hari agar malam hari dapat dialokasikan untuk istirahat total.
suggested_chips: Kepala pusing tiap pagi gara-gara kurang tidur
topics.sample_question: I pulled three all-nighters this week to submit programming projects. Today my vision is blurry, I have a migraine, and I can barely keep my eyes open in lecture.
topics.sample_answer: All-nighters might submit a paper, but they borrow energy from your health with catastrophic interest rates. Let's restructure your daylight hours so your nights remain sacred for recovery.
topics.keywords: begadang tugas, all nighter, kurang tidur, migrain kurang tidur, begadang kuliah, ngantuk kelas

topics.name: Mimpi Buruk Berulang & Ketegangan Tidur
topics.description: Tidur yang sering diganggu mimpi buruk atau terbangun dalam kondisi jantung berdebar karena membawa beban stres harian ke alam bawah sadar.
topics.prompt_context: Pengguna terganggu oleh mimpi buruk atau tidur tegang. Bantu dekompresi emosi sebelum berbaring dan relaksasi otot progresif.
topics.sample_question: I've been having vivid nightmares and intense dreams almost every night. It feels like my brain never gets a moment of peace even when I am asleep.
topics.sample_answer: Nightmares often reflect unprocessed daytime stress lingering in our subconscious. Journaling your worries before bed can act as a mental closing bracket for your day.
topics.keywords: nightmare, mimpi buruk, tidur gelisah, tegang, kaget bangun, tidur tidak nyenyak

topics.name: Kelelahan Bangun Tidur (Sleep Inertia) & Mengantuk Saat Kuliah Siang
topics.description: Kondisi kepala berat, disorientasi, dan rasa lemas yang bertahan berjam-jam setelah bangun tidur meskipun durasi tidur sudah cukup.
topics.prompt_context: Pengguna mengalami sleep inertia parah. Sarankan paparan sinar matahari pagi dan minum segelas air putih segera setelah bangun tidur.
suggested_chips: Bangun tidur kepala berat dan pusing
Mengantuk parah pas jam kuliah siang
Badan lemas padahal tidur udah 8 jam
Susah banget ngumpulin nyawa di pagi hari
topics.sample_question: Even when I sleep 8 hours, I wake up feeling like I was hit by a truck. The grogginess lasts until noon, and I constantly nod off during 1 PM lectures.
topics.sample_answer: Sleep inertia is aggravated by waking up during deep REM cycles or dehydration. Drink a full glass of water immediately upon waking and expose your eyes to natural sunlight for 10 minutes.
topics.keywords: sleep inertia, kepala berat bangun tidur, mengantuk kuliah siang, groggy, susah bangun pagi

topics.name: Ketergantungan Kafein / Kopi Berlebihan untuk Menjaga Melek
topics.description: Mengonsumsi 3-5 cangkir kopi atau minuman berenergi setiap hari hingga memicu tremor tangan, jantung berdebar, dan asam lambung kambuh.
topics.prompt_context: Pengguna kecanduan kafein untuk kompensasi lelah. Sarankan tapering-off kafein secara bertahap dan ganti dengan hidrasi air putih serta peregangan tubuh.
suggested_chips: Asam lambung kambuh karena ngopi terus
Nggak bisa mikir kalau belum ngopi
topics.sample_question: I drink four large iced coffees every single day just to survive college. My hands are shaking, my stomach burns with acid reflux, but without caffeine I collapse.
topics.sample_answer: Using caffeine to mask exhaustion is like putting black tape over the check-engine light in a car. Let's gradually taper down your intake and replace the second cup with cold water.
topics.keywords: kafein, kopi berlebih, tremor kopi, asam lambung kafein, kecanduan kopi, minuman energi

topics.name: Overthinking Saat Kepala Menyentuh Bantal yang Mengusir Kantuk
topics.description: Rasa kantuk yang hilang seketika saat berbaring di kasur karena pikiran langsung memutar daftar kekhawatiran dan rencana esok hari.
topics.prompt_context: Pengguna mengalami conditioned bedtime arousal. Terapkan '20-Minute Rule': jika tidak tidur dalam 20 menit, bangun dari kasur dan baca buku di tempat remang.
suggested_chips: Pas di sofa ngantuk giliran di kasur melek
Pikiran langsung ribut pas kepala nyentuh bantal
Bolak-balik posisi tidur tetap nggak bisa terlelap
topics.sample_question: I feel exhausted on the bus, but the moment my head hits the pillow at night, my eyes pop wide open and my mind starts racing with tomorrow's worries.
topics.sample_answer: Your brain has accidentally associated your bed with anxiety rather than sleep. If you aren't asleep after 20 minutes, leave the bed. Do a boring activity in dim light until sleepiness returns.
topics.keywords: susah tidur ranjang, 20 minute rule, melek di kasur, overthinking kasur, kantuk hilang

topics.name: Membangun Rutinitas Sleep Hygiene yang Sehat dan Konsisten
topics.description: Keinginan untuk memperbaiki jadwal tidur, merancang ritual relaksasi sebelum tidur, dan menciptakan suasana kamar tidur yang tenang.
topics.prompt_context: Pengguna ingin membangun sleep hygiene. Bantu rancang ritual 30 menit sebelum tidur: matikan lampu utama, peregangan ringan, dan aroma terapi.
suggested_chips: Pengen benerin jam tidur yang kacau
Cara bikin ritual tidur yang bikin rileks
Tips sleep hygiene buat anak kosan
topics.sample_question: I want to fix my messy sleep habits once and for all. How can I create a peaceful nighttime routine that actually helps me fall asleep consistently?
topics.sample_answer: Consistency is king for your circadian rhythm. Set a fixed wake-up time even on weekends, dim screens an hour before bed, and treat your bedroom as a sacred resting sanctuary.
topics.keywords: sleep hygiene, ritual tidur, rutinitas malam, benerin jam tidur, jadwal tidur teratur

subcategories.name: Manajemen Waktu, Fokus & Kebiasaan Digital
subcategories.description: Prokrastinasi, distraksi smartphone/media sosial berlebihan, dan kesulitan menjaga konsentrasi belajar.

topics.name: Prokrastinasi Kronis & Siklus Panik Menjelang Batas Akhir
topics.description: Mengetahui pekerjaan itu penting tetapi terus menunda hingga menit-menit terakhir, lalu diakhiri kepanikan dan penyesalan mendalam.
topics.prompt_context: Pengguna bergulat dengan kebiasaan menunda. Ingatkan bahwa prokrastinasi bukanlah kemalasan, melainkan mekanisme menghindar dari emosi cemas tugas.
suggested_chips: To-do list numpuk tapi mager parah
Panik pas udah di ujung deadline
topics.sample_question: I keep procrastinating on important projects until the very last hour. Then I panic, stay up all night, and hate myself for not starting earlier. I don't know how to stop this cycle.
topics.sample_answer: Procrastination is rarely about laziness; it's an emotional avoidance of anxiety or perfectionism. Try working on the task for just 5 minutes with low expectations—starting is the hardest part.
topics.keywords: procrastination, prokrastinasi, menunda tugas, mager, mepet deadline, to-do list, malas nugas

topics.name: Doomscrolling Medsos (TikTok/IG/Twitter) Berjam-jam Tanpa Henti
topics.description: Tergoda membuka Instagram/TikTok berjam-jam saat harus belajar, kehilangan fokus, dan merasa waktu terkuras sia-sia.
topics.prompt_context: Pengguna kecanduan doomscrolling gawai. Bantu ciptakan friksi fisik (menaruh HP di ruangan berbeda saat belajar) dan dorong dopamine detox terukur.
suggested_chips: Susah lepas dari HP pas mau nugas
topics.sample_question: I spend 6 to 8 hours doomscrolling on my phone every day. It distracts me from studying, fries my attention span, and leaves me feeling empty and anxious.
topics.sample_answer: Algorithms are designed to capture and hold our attention aggressively. Let's create intentional friction—like placing your phone across the room or using app timers—to reclaim your mental focus.
topics.keywords: screen time, hp, gadget, medsos, doomscrolling, tiktok, instagram, kecanduan layar, fokus pecah

topics.name: Rentang Fokus yang Memendek & Gampang Terdifraksi saat Belajar
topics.description: Ketidakmampuan membaca materi kuliah lebih dari 10 menit tanpa dorongan untuk memeriksa ponsel atau beralih ke tab browser lain.
topics.prompt_context: Pengguna mengalami rentang fokus memendek. Terapkan teknik Pomodoro (25 menit belajar, 5 menit istirahat penuh tanpa layar).
suggested_chips: Susah fokus belajar lebih dari 15 menit
Pikiran gampang melayang pas baca jurnal
Dikit-dikit buka tab lain pas nugas
topics.sample_question: My attention span is completely shot. I try reading a research paper, and two minutes in, I catch myself opening YouTube or checking notifications without even thinking.
topics.sample_answer: Our brains adapt to rapid digital stimulation by craving novelty. Rebuild your focus muscle using the Pomodoro technique: commit to just 25 minutes of single-tasking, followed by a true 5-minute break.
topics.keywords: fokus pendek, rentang konsentrasi, terdistraksi, pomodoro, perhatian buyar, gagal fokus

topics.name: Kesulitan Menyusun Skala Prioritas antara Kuliah, Hobi, dan Istirahat
topics.description: Kekacauan jadwal harian di mana semua hal terasa mendesak dan penting, sehingga tidak ada waktu tersisa untuk diri sendiri.
topics.prompt_context: Pengguna bingung skala prioritas. Gunakan Eisenhower Matrix (Penting vs Mendesak) untuk mengeliminasi aktivitas penguras waktu.
suggested_chips: Bingung bagi waktu antara kuliah dan hidup
Semua hal rasanya penting dan mendesak
Nggak punya waktu luang buat istirahat
topics.sample_question: I have no idea how to prioritize. My club demands time, my classes have daily homework, and my friends want to hang out. I end up doing a little bit of everything poorly.
topics.sample_answer: When everything is top priority, nothing actually is. Let's use the Eisenhower Matrix: categorize your tasks into what truly moves the needle today versus what can be delegated or deleted.
topics.keywords: skala prioritas, manajemen waktu, eisenhower matrix, bagi waktu kuliah, jadwal harian

topics.name: Beban Mental Multitasking yang Mengakibatkan Pekerjaan Berantakan
topics.description: Membuka 20 tab browser, mengetik esai sambil menonton podcast dan membalas chat, yang berujung pada kelelahan mental tanpa hasil tuntas.
topics.prompt_context: Pengguna kecanduan multitasking. Jelaskan bahwa multitasking sebenarnya adalah task-switching cepat yang menguras glukosa otak.
suggested_chips: Suka ngerjain banyak hal sekaligus tapi nggak ada yang kelar
Buka puluhan tab sekaligus bikin pusing
Nugas sambil nonton video malah bikin lemot
topics.sample_question: I constantly multitask—writing a report while watching a video essay and chatting on Discord. By evening, my brain feels fried and my report is full of typos.
topics.sample_answer: Multitasking is a myth; your brain is rapidly switching between tasks, leaking mental energy at every shift. Practice 'monotasking': close every tab except the single document you're writing.
topics.keywords: multitasking, monotasking, buka banyak tab, beralih tugas, kelelahan kognitif, fokus satu hal

topics.name: Kecanduan Notifikasi Ponsel & Ketidakmampuan Jauh dari Gawai
topics.description: Rasa gelisah luar biasa jika ponsel tidak berada di dekat tangan, dorongan mengecek notifikasi setiap 2 menit sekalipun tidak berbunyi.
topics.prompt_context: Pengguna mengalami phantom notification anxiety. Sarankan mematikan notifikasi non-esensial dan mengubah layar ponsel ke grayscale.
suggested_chips: Sering ngerasa hp getar padahal nggak ada notif
Dorongan ngecek hp tiap beberapa menit
topics.sample_question: I feel genuine phantom vibrations in my pocket even when my phone is on my desk. I feel anxious and naked whenever my battery dies or I'm away from Wi-Fi.
topics.sample_answer: Notification pings trigger dopamine spikes similar to slot machines. Turn off all non-essential badges and alerts. Try setting your phone to grayscale mode to make it visually unappealing.
topics.keywords: kecanduan notifikasi, phantom vibration, nomophobia, tidak bisa lepas hp, screen addiction

topics.name: Merasa Hari Berjalan Begitu Cepat Tanpa Ada Hasil yang Bermakna
topics.description: Penyesalan di malam hari karena merasa seharian sibuk di depan layar gawai/laptop namun tidak ada satu pun tugas penting yang selesai.
topics.prompt_context: Pengguna mengalami sindrom 'busy but unproductive'. Bantu menetapkan 1 hingga 3 'Highlight of the Day' yang terukur setiap pagi.
suggested_chips: Hari cepat banget berlalu tapi nggak ngapa-ngapain
Seharian sibuk tapi nggak ada hasil nyata
Nyesel tiap malam liat to-do list utuh
topics.sample_question: I sit at my desk from 9 AM to 9 PM, but at the end of the day, I haven't finished a single major task. I feel busy all day, but completely unproductive.
topics.sample_answer: Being busy is not the same as being effective. Instead of a massive list of 15 chores, choose just ONE essential 'daily highlight' each morning that makes you feel accomplished.
topics.keywords: waktu terbuang, busy unproductive, hari cepat lewat, tidak ada hasil, penyesalan malam

subcategories.name: Citra Tubuh (Body Image) & Kesehatan Fisik
subcategories.description: Kecemasan berat badan, penampilan fisik, pola makan tidak teratur akibat beban emosi (emotional eating).

topics.name: Ketidakpuasan Citra Tubuh (Body Insecurity) & Rasa Rendah Diri
topics.description: Merasa malu dengan penampilan fisik, bentuk tubuh, atau kulit wajah akibat membandingkan diri dengan standar kecantikan di media sosial.
topics.prompt_context: Pengguna merasa insecure dengan fisiknya. Ajak fokus pada 'Body Neutrality'—menghargai fungsi tubuh yang menopang kehidupan daripada estetika semu.
suggested_chips: Malu liat cermin atau foto diri
topics.sample_question: I feel so self-conscious and insecure about my body image and weight. Seeing perfect influencers on social media makes me hate my physical appearance.
topics.sample_answer: Social media feeds are curated highlights and digital filters, not reality. Your worth as a person is not measured by clothing sizes or beauty trends. Let's practice appreciating what your body does for you daily.
topics.keywords: body image, fisik, berat badan, insecure fisik, rupa, penampilan, cantik, kurus, gemuk

topics.name: Membandingkan Penampilan Fisik dengan Standar Kecantikan Medsos
topics.description: Obsesi membandingkan lekuk tubuh, warna kulit, atau jerawat wajah dengan foto model di Instagram/TikTok yang sudah diedit dan berfilter.
topics.prompt_context: Pengguna terobsesi filter kecantikan medsos. Dorong 'Social Media Diet' dengan meng-unfollow akun pemicu insecurity fisik.
suggested_chips: Minder liat muka glowing orang di TikTok
Ngerasa insecure sama jerawat dan warna kulit
Selalu pengen pakai filter pas foto
topics.sample_question: I can't stop comparing my skin and waistline to influencers. Even though I know they use beauty filters and studio lighting, looking in the mirror makes me feel repulsive.
topics.sample_answer: Consuming filtered imagery trains your brain to treat digital distortions as biological baselines. Unfollow or mute accounts that trigger self-loathing, and re-anchor in real-life beauty.
topics.keywords: standar kecantikan, filter medsos, jerawat, kulit, glowing, insecure wajah, media diet

topics.name: Pola Makan Stres (Emotional Binge Eating) Sebagai Pelarian Emosi
topics.description: Makan makanan manis atau cepat saji dalam porsi besar di malam hari untuk meredakan rasa cemas, kesepian, atau kekosongan batin.
topics.prompt_context: Pengguna mengalami binge eating emosional. Bantu kenali lapar fisik vs lapar emosional dan carikan sarana katarsis non-makanan.
suggested_chips: Kalau stres bawaannya pengen ngunyah terus
Binge eating tengah malam pas lagi cemas
Merasa bersalah dan begah habis makan banyak
topics.sample_question: Whenever I feel overwhelmed with study deadlines or loneliness, I order large pizzas and sugary drinks late at night. I eat until I'm sick, then drown in shame.
topics.sample_answer: Emotional eating is an attempt to soothe psychological distress with dopamine from food. Acknowledge the emotional hunger without beating yourself up, and let's find soothing non-food outlets.
topics.keywords: binge eating, emotional eating, stres makan, makan tengah malam, pelarian makanan, rasa bersalah makan

topics.name: Hilang Nafsu Makan Total Saat Sedang Banyak Pikiran / Ujian
topics.description: Perut mual dan menolak makanan saat sedang menghadapi pekan ujian atau konflik percintaan, menyebabkan tubuh lemas dan berat badan anjlok.
topics.prompt_context: Pengguna kehilangan nafsu makan akibat cemas. Anjurkan asupan nutrisi berbentuk cair (smoothie, sup, susu) yang mudah dicerna saat cemas.
suggested_chips: Nggak ada nafsu makan sama sekali pas cemas
Mulut rasanya pahit dan mual liat makanan
Berat badan turun drastis gara-gara stres
topics.sample_question: When exam stress hits, my appetite completely vanishes. The thought of chewing food makes me nauseous. I've lost 4 kilograms in two weeks and feel faint.
topics.sample_answer: Anxiety activates the sympathetic nervous system, shutting down digestion. When solid food feels impossible, nourish your body with liquids—warm broths, smoothies, or fruit juices.
topics.keywords: hilang nafsu makan, mual cemas, tidak bisa makan, stres ujian makan, berat badan anjlok

topics.name: Gangguan Somatik Terkait Stres (Maag, GERD, Sakit Kepala Migrain)
topics.description: Penyakit lambung (GERD) dan migrain yang selalu kambuh tepat di saat-saat penuh tekanan akademik atau konflik emosional.
topics.prompt_context: Pengguna mengalami gangguan psikosomatis. Edukasi hubungan 'Gut-Brain Axis' dan sarankan konsultasi medis bersamaan dengan manajemen stres.
suggested_chips: Asam lambung / gerd sering kambuh pas stres
Badan gampang sakit pas lagi tertekan
topics.sample_question: Every time finals arrive, my GERD flares up terribly. Acid burns my throat and I get migraines that keep me in bed. Doctor says it's purely triggered by stress.
topics.sample_answer: Your gut contains hundreds of millions of neurons intimately wired to your emotional brain (the gut-brain axis). Managing your stress is just as vital as taking antacids. Let's calm your nervous system.
topics.keywords: psikosomatis, gerd, maag stres, asam lambung, migrain, sakit kepala stres, gut brain axis

topics.name: Menghindari Kaca / Foto Bersama karena Malu dengan Penampilan
topics.description: Kecenderungan menolak diajak foto bersama teman kampus atau sengaja menghindari cermin karena benci melihat penampilan diri sendiri.
topics.prompt_context: Pengguna mengalami mirror avoidance/dysmorphia ringan. Bantu latihan netralitas diri tanpa memaksakan cinta tubuh palsu (toxic body positivity).
suggested_chips: Malu banget kalau diajak foto bareng
Ngerasa muka ancur pas difoto orang lain
Selalu sembunyi di belakang pas foto kelas
topics.sample_question: Whenever classmates want to take a group photo, I hide in the back or volunteer to hold the camera. Seeing my face or body in photos ruins my mood for days.
topics.sample_answer: A photograph is a flat 2D capture frozen in harsh light; it does not capture your warmth, voice, or dynamic presence. Don't let insecurity rob you of memories with friends.
topics.keywords: menghindar foto, malu difoto, benci cermin, mirror avoidance, insecure foto bersama

topics.name: Membangun Hubungan Damai dengan Tubuh (Body Neutrality)
topics.description: Belajar melepaskan obsesi kecantikan dan mulai menghargai organ tubuh yang sehat, kaki yang bisa berjalan, dan paru-paru yang bernapas.
topics.prompt_context: Pengguna ingin berdamai dengan fisiknya. Ajarkan konsep 'Body Neutrality': mengalihkan fokus dari 'apakah tubuhku cantik' ke 'apa yang bisa tubuhku lakukan'.
suggested_chips: Pengen berdamai sama bentuk tubuh sendiri
topics.sample_question: I'm exhausted from hating my body, but I can't force myself to feel beautiful either. How can I just make peace with my physical appearance?
topics.sample_answer: Body neutrality is the healthy middle ground between self-loathing and forced body positivity. You don't have to love how your body looks today; just thank it for carrying you through life.
topics.keywords: body neutrality, damai tubuh, bersyukur fisik, menghargai tubuh, lepas standar kecantikan

subcategories.name: Koping Positif & Praktik Self-Care Harian
subcategories.description: Latihan mindfulness, journaling emosi, penjelajahan hobi baru, dan afirmasi welas asih pada diri sendiri.

topics.name: Latihan Pernapasan Kotak (Box Breathing) & Relaksasi Otot
topics.description: Teknik praktis menenangkan sistem saraf simpatik melalui pernapasan sadar, meditasi terpandu, dan kesadaran momen saat ini.
topics.prompt_context: Pengguna mencari metode praktis untuk relaksasi mental mandiri. Berikan instruksi latihan napas kotak (Box Breathing) 4 detik secara langsung dan aplikatif.
suggested_chips: Butuh cara buat bikin pikiran tenang
topics.sample_question: I've been practicing deep breathing exercises and mindfulness, and it's amazing how simple techniques can bring clarity. How can I integrate them into my daily routine?
topics.sample_answer: Start small: anchor your mindfulness to existing habits, like taking three conscious, deep breaths before opening your books or eating a meal. Micro-practices build long-term resilience.
topics.keywords: mindfulness, breathing, napas, meditasi, relaksasi, grounding, tenang, self care, hening

topics.name: Grounding 5-4-3-2-1 Saat Mengalami Lonjakan Cemas Tiba-Tiba
topics.description: Metode stabilisasi sensorik darurat: melihat 5 benda, menyentuh 4 tekstur, mendengar 3 suara, mencium 2 aroma, dan mengecap 1 rasa.
topics.prompt_context: Pengguna mengalami lonjakan cemas akut. Pandu langkah demi langkah metode sensorik 5-4-3-2-1 secara interaktif.
suggested_chips: Cara grounding pas lagi panik tiba-tiba
Gimana balikin fokus saat pikiran melayang?
topics.sample_question: Whenever a panic wave hits me in public, I feel detached from reality. I need an immediate, tangible tool to pull me back to the present moment.
topics.sample_answer: Look around your room right now: name 5 things you can see, touch 4 distinct textures, identify 3 sounds, notice 2 scents, and taste 1 thing. This sensory anchor tells your brain: 'I am safe here.'
topics.keywords: grounding 54321, teknik grounding, sensorik penenang, panik darurat, hadir saat ini

topics.name: Journaling Curhat Emosi untuk Mengurai Keruwetan Kepala
topics.description: Menumpahkan segala emosi, kemarahan, atau kebingungan ke dalam buku catatan harian (journal) sebagai bentuk katarsis psikologis yang aman.
topics.prompt_context: Pengguna tertarik pada journaling. Berikan panduan 'Brain Dump': tuliskan segala hal tanpa mengoreksi tata bahasa atau estetika tulisan.
suggested_chips: Cara mengurai isi kepala lewat tulisan
topics.sample_question: My head feels like a tangled ball of yarn. I want to try journaling, but I don't know where to start or what to write about.
topics.sample_answer: Journaling is not about writing literature; it's about brain-dumping emotional clutter onto paper so you don't have to carry it in your skull. Write without filtering for 5 minutes.
topics.keywords: journaling, diary curhat, nulis jurnal, katarsis emosi, brain dump, buku harian

topics.name: Berjalan Santai di Alam Terbuka (Nature Walk) sebagai Katarsis
topics.description: Mengurangi stres perkuliahan dengan berjalan kaki di taman kampus, menghirup udara segar, dan memutus kontak dari layar gawai.
topics.prompt_context: Pengguna mencari penyegaran mental alami. Dorong jalan santai 15 menit di area hijau kampus tanpa earphone untuk regenerasi fokus.
suggested_chips: Jalan santai di taman kampus buat ademin kepala
Manfaat jalan kaki buat redakan stres
Butuh udara segar jauh dari kosan
topics.sample_question: I've been feeling suffocated in my room. A long walk through the park yesterday gave me an unexpected sense of calm and clarity. How does nature help?
topics.sample_answer: Walking in green spaces lowers cortisol levels and gives your directed attention a break. Make a 15-minute unplugged nature walk a regular weekly sanctuary for your mental health.
topics.keywords: nature walk, jalan santai, taman kampus, udara segar, jalan kaki stres, healing alam

topics.name: Eksplorasi Seni Kreatif (Menggambar, Musik) Pereda Ketegangan
topics.description: Menyalurkan unek-unek perasaan ke dalam lukisan, petikan gitar, doodle, atau kerajinan tangan tanpa tuntutan hasil harus bernilai seni tinggi.
topics.prompt_context: Pengguna menyukai seni/kreativitas. Kuatkan bahwa nilai seni terapi terletak pada proses ekspresi, bukan penilaian keindahan produk akhir.
suggested_chips: Seni dan musik bantu bikin adem
Mau gambar doodle buat redakan cemas
topics.sample_question: I picked up my sketchbook after months of neglect, and just scribbling with colored pencils made my chest feel lighter. Creative expression feels like therapy for me.
topics.sample_answer: Art and music bypass our analytical defenses and allow raw emotions to be expressed non-verbally. Keep creating for the pure joy of the process, completely free of judgment.
topics.keywords: art therapy, seni kreatif, melukis, musik, doodle, gambar, katarsis seni, ekspresi kreatif

topics.name: Mempraktikkan Self-Compassion (Welas Asih pada Diri Sendiri)
topics.description: Belajar memaafkan kegagalan masa lalu, memperlakukan diri dengan penuh kehangatan, dan melepaskan standar kesempurnaan yang menyiksa.
topics.prompt_context: Pengguna ingin belajar mencintai diri sendiri. Ajarkan 3 pilar Self-Compassion Dr. Kristin Neff: kebaikan diri, kemanusiaan bersama, dan mindfulness.
suggested_chips: Gimana cara berdamai sama masa lalu?
Pengen lebih sayang sama diri sendiri
Berhenti jadi musuh terberat diri sendiri
topics.sample_question: I want to focus on gratitude and forgiveness, trying to forgive myself for my mistakes and move forward with a gentler, more compassionate heart.
topics.sample_answer: Self-compassion means treating yourself as someone you care about when times are tough. You are human, which means you are allowed to make mistakes and learn without withholding love from yourself.
topics.keywords: self compassion, welas asih, maafkan diri, damai, sayang diri, bersyukur, gentle, pulih

topics.name: Membangun Rutinitas Pagi yang Menenangkan Sebelum Kuliah
topics.description: Menghindari kebiasaan bangun terburu-buru dan langsung memeriksa medsos; menggantinya dengan peregangan ringan dan sarapan tenang.
topics.prompt_context: Pengguna ingin mengubah pagi hari yang penuh panik menjadi tenang. Bantu rancang rutinitas pagi 20 menit tanpa gawai.
suggested_chips: Mau bikin rutinitas pagi yang santai
Capek tiap pagi terburu-buru dan panik
Tips memulai hari dengan pikiran tenang
Bangun pagi tanpa langsung cek medsos
topics.sample_question: Every morning starts with panic—waking up late, grabbing my phone, getting stressed by notifications, and rushing to class. I want a calmer start to my day.
topics.sample_answer: How you spend the first 30 minutes of your day sets your nervous system's tone. Delay screen time, drink a tall glass of water, and stretch for 5 minutes before engaging the outside world.
topics.keywords: rutinitas pagi, morning routine, bangun tenang, peregangan pagi, sarapan tenang, tanpa hp pagi

name: Bantuan Profesional, Pemulihan & Krisis
description: Jembatan konsultasi psikolog/psikiater, penghapusan stigma kesehatan mental, pemulihan kebiasaan buruk, dan protokol darurat.

subcategories.name: Kesiapan Konseling & Edukasi Kesehatan Mental
subcategories.description: Keraguan memulai terapi profesional, ketakutan dicap 'tidak waras', dan memahami peran psikolog vs psikiater.

topics.name: Rasa Ragu, Malu, atau Takut Memulai Sesi Konseling Pertama Kali
topics.description: Ketakutan akan stigma masyarakat saat berkonsultasi ke psikolog/psikiater, serta kebingungan mengenai apa yang harus dikatakan saat sesi pertama.
topics.prompt_context: Pengguna ragu atau malu pergi ke profesional. Jelaskan bahwa mencari bantuan psikologis adalah tanda keberanian dan kebijaksanaan, bukan kelemahan.
suggested_chips: Malu dan takut pergi ke psikolog
Takut dianggap gila sama orang lain
Kapan waktu yang tepat buat konseling?
topics.sample_question: I've never thought about meeting a therapist before, it's a completely new idea for me. I'm afraid people will judge me or think I'm crazy if I seek counseling.
topics.sample_answer: Seeking professional counseling is as normal and healthy as visiting a doctor when you have a persistent cough. A therapist offers an objective, confidential, and safe space without judgment.
topics.keywords: therapy, therapist, counselor, konseling, psikolog, psikiater, malu, stigma, konsultasi

topics.name: Kekhawatiran Dicap 'Tidak Waras' atau Mengada-ada oleh Lingkungan
topics.description: Kekhawatiran keluarga atau teman akan mengolok-olok atau menganggap masalah mentalnya hanyalah 'kurang bersyukur' atau 'cari perhatian'.
topics.prompt_context: Pengguna tertekan oleh stigma lingkungan sekitar. Validasi bahwa rasa sakit emosional mereka nyata dan berhak mendapatkan pertolongan ahli.
suggested_chips: Takut dicap lebay atau cari perhatian
Keluarga nganggep masalah mental cuma rekayasa
Malu ketahuan teman kalau konsultasi ke psikolog
topics.sample_question: My roommates saw a counseling brochure on my desk and joked about sending people to an asylum. I feel so humiliated and terrified of anyone finding out.
topics.sample_answer: Stigma comes from ignorance and fear. Taking care of your psychological well-being is a sign of immense maturity. Your medical and counseling records are strictly confidential.
topics.keywords: stigma mental, dicap gila, cari perhatian, kurang bersyukur, cemoohan lingkungan, tabu konseling

topics.name: Memahami Perbedaan Layanan Psikolog Klinis vs Dokter Psikiater
topics.description: Kebingungan membedakan layanan konseling psikologis (psikoterapi) dengan penanganan medis kedokteran jiwa (psikiater dan medikasi).
topics.prompt_context: Pengguna bingung memilih antara psikolog atau psikiater. Berikan penjelasan edukatif yang netral dan informatif mengenai ranah masing-masing profesi.
suggested_chips: Apakah harus minum obat dari dokter jiwa?
Mau tahu alur rujukan BPJS buat konseling
topics.sample_question: I feel my anxiety is getting out of hand, but I don't know whether I need a counselor, a clinical psychologist, or a psychiatrist who prescribes medications.
topics.sample_answer: Psychologists focus primarily on psychotherapy and talk-based coping strategies, whereas psychiatrists are medical doctors who can prescribe medication alongside therapy if chemical balance needs support.
topics.keywords: psikolog, psikiater, medikasi, obat, resep dokter, bpjs, alur rujukan, psikiatri, konsultasi medis

topics.name: Ketakutan & Informasi Mengenai Efek Samping Obat Medis Psikiatri
topics.description: Kekhawatiran berlebihan bahwa mengonsumsi antidepresan atau obat anti-cemas akan membuat kecanduan seumur hidup atau merusak otak.
topics.prompt_context: Pengguna takut minum obat psikiatri yang diresepkan. Berikan edukasi medis objektif bahwa medikasi di bawah pengawasan psikiater aman dan terukur.
suggested_chips: Efek samping obat psikiater bikin lemas?
Apakah harus minum obat seumur hidup?
Mau tahu cara kerja obat cemas
topics.sample_question: A psychiatrist prescribed me SSRIs for severe panic, but I'm terrified they'll alter my personality or hook me on pills forever. I haven't taken them yet.
topics.sample_answer: Psychiatric medications balance neurotransmitters just like insulin balances diabetes. Modern medications are non-addictive when managed by a doctor. Discuss all concerns directly with your prescribing physician.
topics.keywords: obat psikiatri, antidepresan, ssri, anti cemas, efek samping obat, kecanduan obat, psikiater

topics.name: Edukasi Hak Kerahasiaan Konseling (Confidentiality) dan Privasi Klien
topics.description: Ketakutan bahwa apa yang diceritakan saat konseling akan dilaporkan ke pihak kampus, dosen wali, atau dibocorkan ke orang tua.
topics.prompt_context: Pengguna cemas soal privasi konseling. Jelaskan kode etik kerahasiaan konselor profesional (Confidentiality Agreement) yang dijamin hukum.
suggested_chips: Apakah curhat ke konselor kampus aman dan rahasia?
Takut konselor lapor ke dosen atau ortu
topics.sample_question: I want to see the campus counselor, but I'm afraid they will put my depression on my academic transcript or call my parents behind my back.
topics.sample_answer: Licensed mental health professionals are legally and ethically bound by confidentiality. Nothing you say leaves the room unless there is immediate, life-threatening danger to yourself or others.
topics.keywords: kerahasiaan konseling, confidentiality, privasi data, kode etik psikolog, lapor ortu, aman curhat

topics.name: Cara Mengakses Konseling Kampus atau Menggunakan Rujukan BPJS
topics.description: Kebingungan mengenai langkah birokrasi pendaftaran konseling di unit layanan mahasiswa kampus atau faskes pertama BPJS Kesehatan.
topics.prompt_context: Pengguna butuh panduan praktis alur rujukan. Berikan langkah konkrit: periksa faskes tingkat 1 BPJS, minta rujukan ke poli jiwa/psikologi RSUD.
suggested_chips: Alur pakai BPJS buat konseling psikolog gimana?
topics.sample_question: I want to get professional help, but I can't afford private clinic rates of 500k per session. How do I access mental health coverage through BPJS or university services?
topics.sample_answer: Mental healthcare is covered by BPJS. Visit your registered Faskes 1 (Puskesmas/Klinik), explain your symptoms, and ask for a referral to the hospital's psychiatry or clinical psychology clinic.
topics.keywords: bpjs konseling, alur rujukan bpjs, puskesmas jiwa, konseling gratis, faskes 1, biaya psikolog

topics.name: Cara Mengomunikasikan Kondisi Mental ke Orang Tua yang Skeptis
topics.description: Kesulitan meminta izin atau dukungan biaya dari orang tua untuk pergi ke psikolog karena orang tua menganggap masalah mental hal tabu.
topics.prompt_context: Pengguna butuh tips bicara ke orang tua skeptis. Sarankan fokus pada gejala fisik yang objektif (insomnia, penurunan nafsu makan, nilai) agar lebih mudah dipahami orang tua.
suggested_chips: Gimana cara minta izin ke ortu buat ke psikolog?
Ortu nggak percaya sama penyakit mental
Cara ngomong ke keluarga kalau butuh bantuan
topics.sample_question: I need my parents' financial support to see a therapist, but they think mental health issues are fictional excuses. How can I explain my condition without being mocked?
topics.sample_answer: Frame the conversation around physical, functional impacts rather than abstract emotional terms: explain that you cannot sleep, have chronic migraines, and your academic focus is severely impaired.
topics.keywords: komunikasi orang tua, minta izin psikolog, ortu skeptis, edukasi orang tua, biaya terapi ortu

subcategories.name: Pemulihan dari Kebiasaan Merusak Diri & Adiksi
subcategories.description: Proses melepaskan diri dari siklus adiksi (game, judi online, substansi, atau perilaku impulsif) dan mengelola kekambuhan.

topics.name: Siklus Menghentikan Kecanduan Game Online yang Mengganggu Kuliah
topics.description: Bermain game kompetitif 10-14 jam sehari sebagai pelarian kenyataan, mengabaikan tugas kuliah, dan merasa cemas saat tidak bermain.
topics.prompt_context: Pengguna kecanduan game online. Bantu identifikasi kebutuhan emosional yang dipenuhi oleh game (sense of achievement/komunitas) dan alihkan ke dunia nyata.
suggested_chips: Kecanduan game online sampai bolos kuliah
Nggak bisa berhenti main game seharian
Game jadi pelarian dari stres kuliah
Mau ngurangin jam main game tapi susah
topics.sample_question: I play competitive online games for 12 hours a day to escape my real-life anxiety. I skipped three weeks of lectures, and now I'm facing academic probation.
topics.sample_answer: Gaming provides instant dopamine, clear rewards, and a sense of mastery that real life often lacks. Acknowledging what the game provides you is key to finding healthy offline substitutes.
topics.keywords: game online, kecanduan game, bolos main game, adiksi gaming, pelarian game, screen gaming

topics.name: Perjuangan Melepaskan Ketergantungan Judi Online / Pinjol Ilegal
topics.description: Terjebak lingkaran setan slot/judi online, terjerat utang pinjaman online (pinjol), dan merasa putus asa dikejar penagih utang.
topics.prompt_context: KRITIS: Pengguna terjerat judi online/pinjol. Berikan respon non-judgmental, arahkan mencari bantuan advokasi keuangan/keluarga, dan putus akses perbankan.
suggested_chips: Mau berhenti tapi dikejar rasa penasaran buat balik modal
topics.sample_question: I lost all my tuition money on online gambling slots and now have debts with loan sharks. I am terrified, humiliated, and contemplated ending it all to escape.
topics.sample_answer: Gambling algorithms are engineered to exploit neurochemical vulnerabilities; this is an addiction, not a simple lack of willpower. Please come clean to one trusted mentor or family member today. You can recover.
topics.keywords: judi online, judol, slot, pinjol ilegal, utang pinjol, terjerat utang, uang ukt habis

topics.name: Kecanduan Pornografi / Masturbasi Kompulsif & Perasaan Bersalah
topics.description: Dorongan kompulsif menonton video dewasa setiap kali merasa bosan atau cemas, diikuti perasaan jijik dan hancurnya harga diri.
topics.prompt_context: Pengguna bergulat dengan pornografi kompulsif. Hindari penghakiman moral; fokus pada pemicu stres/kesepian yang mendorong perilaku tersebut.
suggested_chips: Ngerasa kotor dan bersalah sehabis masturbasi
Susah berhenti pas lagi sendirian di kosan
Takut merusak otak dan masa depan
topics.sample_question: I watch adult videos and masturbate compulsively every time I feel stressed or lonely. Afterwards I feel deeply disgusted with myself and wonder why I have no self-control.
topics.sample_answer: Pornography addiction is usually driven by emotional loneliness and boredom, not sheer depravity. Shaming yourself only fuels the cycle of isolation. Let's install blockers and address the emotional void.
topics.keywords: pornografi, bokep, masturbasi kompulsif, pmo, adiksi seksual, rasa bersalah masturbasi

topics.name: Penggunaan Rokok / Zat / Alkohol sebagai Pelarian Beban Mental
topics.description: Merokok berbungkus-bungkus atau mengonsumsi alkohol secara berlebihan sebagai pelarian cepat dari kepenatan mental dan stres perkuliahan.
topics.prompt_context: Pengguna menggunakan zat sebagai koping destruktif. Anjurkan mencari strategi koping sehat alternatif dan konsultasikan ke konselor adiksi.
suggested_chips: Badan batuk dan sesak tapi tetap ngisap
topics.sample_question: I chain-smoke two packs of cigarettes a day and drink heavily on weekends just to numb the pressure of university. My chest hurts, but smoking is the only thing calming my nerves.
topics.sample_answer: Substances offer an immediate chemical illusion of relief, but they worsen biological anxiety once they wear off. Let's find grounded somatic ways to release tension without destroying your lungs.
topics.keywords: rokok, merokok stres, alkohol, mabuk pelarian, zat penenang, kecanduan nikotin, zat adiktif

topics.name: Menghadapi Kekambuhan (Relapse) Tanpa Menghakimi Diri Gagal Total
topics.description: Kekecewaan mendalam setelah berhasil berhenti dari kebiasaan buruk selama berbulan-bulan, namun kambuh kembali akibat pemicu stres tertentu.
topics.prompt_context: Pengguna mengalami relapse. Tegaskan bahwa kekambuhan adalah bagian dari kurva pemulihan (recovery curve), bukan berarti usaha sebelumnya sia-sia.
suggested_chips: Kambuh lagi setelah berhasil berhenti 3 bulan
Ngerasa gagal total dan putus asa
Kecewa berat sama diri sendiri karena relapse
Mulai dari nol lagi rasanya berat
topics.sample_question: I was clean from my addictive habit for 90 days, but last night I slipped up under exam pressure. I feel so devastated, like all my progress was erased.
topics.sample_answer: A relapse does not erase the 90 days of strength you built. Recovery is a spiral staircase, not an escalator. You stumbled on one step, but you are still far higher than where you started. Stand back up.
topics.keywords: relapse, kambuh lagi, gagal berhenti, terpuruk kambuh, kurva pemulihan, mulai lagi

topics.name: Mengidentifikasi Pemicu (Triggers) Lingkungan yang Mendorong Adiksi
topics.description: Memetakan jam-jam rawan (HALT: Hungry, Angry, Lonely, Tired), orang-orang tertentu, atau lokasi yang memicu kambuhnya dorongan adiksi.
topics.prompt_context: Pengguna butuh manajemen pemicu adiksi. Ajarkan konsep HALT dan modifikasi tata letak lingkungan kosan.
suggested_chips: Kapan waktu paling rawan buat kambuh?
Mengubah lingkungan kamar biar nggak tergoda
topics.sample_question: I notice I always slip up late at night when I'm alone, bored, and scrolling on my bed. How do I dismantle these situational triggers?
topics.sample_answer: Addictions thrive on convenience and emotional vulnerability. Remember HALT: never let yourself get too Hungry, Angry, Lonely, or Tired. Change your physical environment to create friction.
topics.keywords: trigger adiksi, pemicu kambuh, halt, lingkungan rawan, jam rawan, dorongan kebiasaan

topics.name: Membangun Lingkungan & Support System Baru yang Mendukung Pemulihan
topics.description: Mencari komunitas pendukung, teman akuntabilitas (accountability partner), dan memutus hubungan dengan lingkungan pergaulan lama yang toksik.
topics.prompt_context: Pengguna membutuhkan support network pemulihan. Bantu cari support group atau teman terpercaya yang bisa diajak berbicara saat dorongan adiksi muncul.
suggested_chips: Butuh teman akuntabilitas buat saling jaga
Cara lepas dari circle lama yang toksik
topics.sample_question: I realize I can't quit on my own while still hanging out with the same friends who engage in these destructive habits. How do I build a healthy support circle?
topics.sample_answer: You cannot heal in the same toxic environment that made you sick. Reaching out to support communities or finding one honest accountability partner will multiply your strength.
topics.keywords: support system, accountability partner, circle sehat, komunitas pemulihan, lepas circle toksik

subcategories.name: Protokol Keamanan, Deteksi Krisis & Dukungan Darurat
subcategories.description: Sinyal bahaya, dorongan melukai diri sendiri, kelelahan hidup ekstrem, serta penyediaan kontak hotline krisis darurat.

topics.name: Kelelahan Hidup Ekstrem & Perasaan Ingin Menyerah dari Segalanya
topics.description: Kondisi di mana beban mental terasa begitu tak tertahankan sehingga muncul pikiran ingin menyerah atau menghilang dari kehidupan.
topics.prompt_context: KRISIS DARURAT: Pengguna mengekspresikan keputusasaan akut. Berikan validasi empati yang mendalam, tanyakan keselamatan fisik langsung, dan berikan nomor kontak darurat (Hotline 119 ext 8 / Into The Light). JANGAN mendebat secara filosofis.
suggested_chips: Rasanya udah nggak kuat lagi ngejalanin hidup
topics.sample_question: I feel like I'm running out of time and energy, and I just can't handle this pain anymore. Sometimes I feel like it would be easier if I just wasn't here at all.
topics.sample_answer: I hear how exhausted and hurt you feel right now. Your life is immensely valuable and you don't have to carry this overwhelming darkness alone. Please reach out to emergency hotline 119 ext 8 or visit your nearest hospital emergency room. People care about you.
topics.keywords: krisis, darurat, menyerah, pengen hilang, capek hidup, lelah luar biasa, butuh bantuan darurat

topics.name: Dorongan Melukai Diri Sendiri (Self-Harm) Sebagai Pelampiasan Sakit
topics.description: Dorongan menyakiti fisik (menggores, memukul diri) untuk mengalihkan rasa sakit emosional yang tidak mampu diungkapkan dengan kata-kata.
topics.prompt_context: KRISIS SELF-HARM: Validasi rasa sakit emosional tanpa membenarkan tindakan melukai fisik. Sarankan metode pengganti aman (menggenggam es batu) dan rujuk ke profesional.
suggested_chips: Ada dorongan buat melukai diri sendiri
Sakit fisik jadi pelampiasan rasa sakit batin
topics.sample_question: Whenever the emotional agony gets too intense, I get the urge to cut myself just to feel something physical instead of the numbness in my head.
topics.sample_answer: I hear that the emotional pain inside feels intolerable right now. But you don't have to hurt your body to release that pain. Try holding an ice cube tightly in your palm or snapping a rubber band on your wrist instead.
topics.keywords: self harm, melukai diri, menggores, sayat tangan, pelampiasan sakit, rasa sakit fisik

topics.name: Pikiran Mengakhiri Hidup (Ide Suisidal) & Butuh Bantuan Darurat
topics.description: Munculnya pemikiran aktif untuk mengakhiri hidup, membuat surat perpisahan, atau mencari cara-cara berbahaya.
topics.prompt_context: PROTOKOL MERAH SUISIDAL: Utamakan keselamatan nyawa. Jangan tinggalkan sendirian, segera arahkan ke IGD Rumah Sakit terdekat atau Hotline Darurat 119 ext 8.
suggested_chips: Pikiran buat mengakhiri hidup muncul terus
Rasanya dunia lebih baik tanpa aku
Tolong bantu aku lagi di titik terendah
Kontak darurat apa yang bisa dihubungi?
topics.sample_question: I've been thinking about ending it all. I feel like my existence is just continuous suffering and I don't see any other way out.
topics.sample_answer: Please stay with me. Your life has immense value, and this unbearable pain can be treated. Please call the emergency health hotline at 119 ext 8 or contact someone you trust immediately. You are not alone.
topics.keywords: suicide, bunuh diri, akhiri hidup, ide suisidal, mati saja, titik terendah, darurat nyawa

topics.name: Menyusun Safety Plan Pribadi Menghadapi Puncak Badai Emosi
topics.description: Penyusunan rencana keselamatan darurat bagi individu yang rentan mengalami gejolak emosi intens agar memiliki daftar kontak aman.
topics.prompt_context: Bantu pengguna menyusun Safety Plan: identifikasi tanda peringatan dini, daftar 3 orang yang dapat dihubungi segera, dan tempat yang aman.
suggested_chips: Gimana cara bikin safety plan saat krisis?
Kontak darurat apa yang bisa dihubungi?
Cara nenangkin diri pas emosi memuncak
Siapa orang terdekat yang bisa kuhubungi?
topics.sample_question: When my emotional waves hit their peak, I get scared I will do something reckless. I need a clear plan of what to do and who to contact before I lose control.
topics.sample_answer: Having a personalized Safety Plan gives you an anchor during emotional storms. Let's write down your top 3 grounding triggers, your safest trusted contact, and professional crisis hotlines.
topics.keywords: safety plan, rencana aman, krisis emosi, mitigasi darurat, langkah keselamatan, support network

topics.name: Daftar Kontak Darurat Kesehatan Mental (Hotline 119 Ext 8, LSM, IGD)
topics.description: Informasi kontak penting layanan krisis nasional, yayasan pencegahan bunuh diri (Into The Light, Sejiwa), dan layanan IGD psikiatri.
topics.prompt_context: Sediakan informasi nomor kontak darurat resmi Indonesia secara akurat dan mudah dihubungi saat darurat.
suggested_chips: Nomor telepon darurat pencegahan bunuh diri
IGD psikiatri terdekat ada di mana?
topics.sample_question: I need a list of phone numbers and emergency services in Indonesia that I can call immediately during a midnight mental health crisis.
topics.sample_answer: Save these numbers right now: Hotline SEJIWA Kementerian Kesehatan (119 ext 8), Layanan Konseling Into The Light Indonesia, atau kunjungi Instalasi Gawat Darurat (IGD) Rumah Sakit terdekat.
topics.keywords: hotline darurat, 119 ext 8, into the light, sejiwa kemenkes, igd psikiatri, nomor darurat

topics.name: Menolong Teman Sebaya yang Berada dalam Kondisi Krisis Emosional
topics.description: Panduan bagi mahasiswa yang melihat teman satu kos atau sahabatnya sedang menangis histeris, melukai diri, atau berniat bunuh diri.
topics.prompt_context: Bantu pengguna menjadi 'First Responder' teman sebaya: dengarkan tanpa menghakimi, jangan tinggalkan sendirian, dan hubungi pihak berwenang kampus/keluarga.
suggested_chips: Teman kosan ngomong pengen bunuh diri
Cara nolong sahabat yang lagi histeris
Apa yang harus kulakuin pas teman krisis?
topics.sample_question: My roommate just broke down, showing cuts on their arm and saying they don't want to live anymore. I'm terrified and don't know what to do to help them safely.
topics.sample_answer: Stay calm and do not leave them alone. Listen empathetically without lecturing or dismissing their pain. Secure any harmful objects, and contact your campus counseling center or emergency services immediately.
topics.keywords: tolong teman, teman krisis, pertolongan pertama krisis, first responder teman, sahabat histeris

topics.name: Menemukan Jangkar Harapan (Reasons for Living) di Saat Tergelap
topics.description: Eksplorasi alasan-alasan kecil untuk bertahan hidup (hewan peliharaan, impian masa depan, senyuman orang tua, tempat yang ingin dikunjungi).
topics.prompt_context: Bantu pengguna mengingat kembali jangkar harapan hidup yang paling bermakna bagi mereka, sekecil apapun itu.
suggested_chips: Mengingat hal-hal kecil yang bikin bersyukur
Alasan untuk tidak menyerah hari ini
Menemukan secercah harapan di masa sulit
topics.sample_question: Everything feels black and hopeless right now. I desperately need to remember even a tiny reason why I should hold on and keep fighting.
topics.sample_answer: Sometimes the anchors that save us are tiny: the feeling of warm sun on your face, a pet that waits for you, a song you haven't heard yet, or the person you haven't met. Hold on for that.
topics.keywords: reasons for living, jangkar harapan, alasan bertahan hidup, bertahan hari ini, secercah harapan

name: Psikologi Finansial & Tekanan Ekonomi
description: Mengurai stres keuangan, perilaku doom spending, beban generasi sandwich, hingga kecemasan masa depan finansial.

subcategories.name: Perilaku Konsumtif & Doom Spending
subcategories.description: Pendampingan dan refleksi terarah seputar perilaku konsumtif & doom spending untuk mengurai beban pikiranmu.

topics.name: Belanja impulsif saat stres
